Who this class is for

For parents of little ones, newborn to 6 years

  • Parents who’d like to understand how sleep works at each age, and what’s typical along the way.
  • Parents who would rather follow a flexible plan than a one-size-fits-all routine.
  • Parents-to-be and new parents who want to feel prepared before the newborn weeks.
  • Anyone who’d like to feel calmer and more confident at bedtime.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover together, live

How sleep changes as they grow

What sleep tends to look like from the newborn weeks to 6 years, and what’s age-appropriate at each stage.

A calm sleep space

How to set up the room, light and wind-down so the space itself supports sleep.

An age-appropriate routine

How to build a day and bedtime routine around your child’s age, rather than forcing one that doesn’t fit.

Naps and early mornings

How naps change with age, and simple ways to think about the start of the day.

An approach that suits your family

The evidence-based options, and how to choose the one that feels right for you.

Meet Katy

Hi, I’m Katy Huyerman

I’m a certified children’s sleep consultant and the founder of Slumbertots. Over the last 10 years I’ve supported over 1,000 families, in person across London and Surrey, and remotely by phone, email and video.

I’m also trained in nutrition, breastfeeding, infant mental health and potty training, and I’m a member of the Association of Professional Sleep Consultants, the British Paediatric Sleep Society and the International Association of Child Sleep Consultants. My mission is to help parents develop confidence in supporting their child to sleep well.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Who is this class for?

Parents, parents-to-be and carers of little ones from newborn to 6 years who’d like a calm, evidence-based introduction to children’s sleep.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay, so you can watch at nap time or after bedtime.

Is this medical advice?

No. It’s an educational class, not medical advice. If you have any concerns about your child’s health or sleep, please speak to your GP or health visitor.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, take what helps, and decide afterwards if you’d like more support.

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice. Filmed with you only (no children on camera). Each ends with an on-screen “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 1 · “No one-size-fits-all”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“After 10 years and over 1,000 families, here’s what I wish every parent knew.”

Body

“There’s no one routine that suits every child. Sleep looks different at every age, and every family is different. The plans that work best are built around your child and your family, not forced onto them.”

CTA

“I’m running a free live masterclass on how little ones sleep, from newborn to 6 years. Tap Sign up to save your seat. The replay is included.”

Shot: talking to camera with a cuppa, blue backdrop, on-screen text “No one-size-fits-all”.

Script 2 · “Three things I look at first”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three things I look at first when a family asks me about bedtime.”

Body

“One: what’s age-appropriate for their child right now. Two: the sleep space itself. Three: the hour before bed. I’ll go through all three, step by step, in my free class.”

CTA

“It’s called the Calmer Nights Masterclass. Tap Sign up below to save your free seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, counting on fingers, numbers 1 to 3 on screen in moon yellow.

Script 3 · “Bring me your questions”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I’m a certified children’s sleep consultant, and I’m answering your questions live.”

Body

“In my free masterclass I’ll walk you through how sleep changes from newborn to 6 years, how to set up a calm sleep space, and how to build a routine that fits your family. Then I’ll stay on for your questions.”

CTA

“Sixty minutes, free, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera at a desk, simple moon and stars graphic with “Live Q&A”.
